title: Normalized Yoneda-to-derived Ext comparison data
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived Ext groups [def-pc-ext], and use concrete Yoneda extensions, endpoint-fixed equivalence classes, splice data and geometric Baer-sum data [def-coef-yoneda-extension-data]. A normalized Yoneda-to-derived Ext comparison datum consists, for all $U,V\in\mathcal A$ and $n\geq0$, of an abelian group structure on the classes of degree-$(n+1)$ extensions of $U$ by $V$ and an additive equivalence $c_{V,U,n}$ from this group to $\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}_{\mathcal A}(U,V)$, together with the following requirements. For a degree-one extension $E$ with endpoint identifications $\ell:V\cong E_{\mathrm{left}}$ and $r:E_{\mathrm{right}}\cong U$, its image is minus the composite of $r^{-1}$, the Mathlib short exact connecting class, and $\ell^{-1}$. For a short exact sequence $S:0\to V\to M\to N\to0$, a degree-$(n+1)$ extension $F$ of $U$ by $N$, and a degree-$(n+2)$ extension $E$ identified with their splice, require $c_{V,U,n+1}([E])=(-1)^n\,\delta_S\circ c_{N,U,n}([F])$. For every morphism $E\to F$ of extensions of the same degree with induced endpoint maps $a:V\to V'$ and $b:U\to U'$, require $b^*c_{V',U',n}([F])=a_*c_{V,U,n}([E])$. Every geometric Baer sum $G$ of $E,F$ has class $[G]=[E]+[F]$, and a geometric Baer sum exists for each pair. In degree one the comparison is zero exactly on split extensions. For every injective $V$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], $\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}_{\mathcal A}(U,V)$ is a subsingleton for every $U,n$. This defines a type of data, without asserting that it is inhabited; it is precisely the existing structure $\mathrm{YonedaDerivedExtComparison}(\mathcal A)$.
